title: Spaghetti Bolognese with Veggie Ground, Mushrooms & Carrots

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, veggie ground, mushrooms, carrots, and spices. Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
Add marinara sauce to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Once the sauce is simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to simmer until the vegetables are soft, 5-6 minutes more.
When the sauce is done, add pasta to the skillet, toss to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
